$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

252:521.name: Card Frame
252:521.description: The constant frame (POSTCARDS.md §1). Only the Content Zone changes between cards. Accent rail and tick bind to type/accent: set the instance's Post Type mode to set the type. Series posts show Day and Series ("21 DAYS OF DEV"); regular posts turn both off. Swap Content to a Content/* archetype. Judge at 320px (Thumbnail Test page).

252:574.name: Content/Empty
252:574.description: Default content for Card Frame. Swap the frame's Content property to a Content/* archetype.

252:635.name: Sheet
252:635.description: The paper sheet a web page sits on: the card stock's tall cut, Imagery/Paper 2:3, stretched over tertiary-container, pinned to the Light scheme (the paper is a light raster). Desktop: an 800px column, a 4px on-secondary border, 20/24/16 padding. Mobile (below 640px): full width, 16px padding, no border. Put the page into Content; children stack 20px apart. .lk-sheet.

252:642.name: Stage
252:642.description: A full-bleed web backdrop: Imagery/Palm Sky, cover, over primary-container. Desktop centres its Page 32px from the top with 16px sides; Mobile runs the page edge to edge. Holds a Sheet. .lk-stage.

81:239.name: Content/Manifesto

Statement.default:
One idea per card.
The tweet carries nuance.

81:239.description: Manifesto · best for Principle. One oversized statement; the payoff line sits on a type/accent highlight. No imagery: the type is the image. Break lines by meaning, 3–5 lines at most. Sample copy from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:247.name: Content/Architecture Diagram
81:247.description: Architecture Diagram · best for Decision, Principle. Two labelled zones, one arrow, one annotation that carries the rule. Chips should be real components exported from the real file. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:262.name: Content/Pipeline
81:262.description: Pipeline · best for Teaching. Source → transform → output. The middle stage is one real terminal command. Highlight exactly one thing in the output. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx; replace with the real pipeline.

81:281.name: Content/Parity
81:281.description: Parity · best for Progress, Teaching. The same thing twice: Figma render left, live code render right, same zoom and crop. The = is the whole argument; any drift undermines the card. Replace both Specimens with real screenshots.

81:294.name: Content/Before After
81:294.description: Before / After · best for Failure. The mistake struck through with error ✕ on the left, the fix with primary ✓ on the right. Red only on the left, the brand accent only on the right; never mix. Equal visual weight. Sample from postcard-wireframes.jsx.

81:305.name: Content/Ledger
81:305.description: Ledger · best for Progress and recaps. A left-aligned checklist of real item names at uneven lengths, 6 lines at most. Subtraction variant: set rows to Struck=Yes for a ledger of what was cut. Sample rows are this library's own build, 2026-09-24.

42:141.name: Link Header
42:141.description: Link page header: the wordmark, then Blog and Shop (Pill Button, Ghost) and Follow (Outlined) at the right. Mobile drops the ghost links and shrinks the wordmark to 26px. .lk-header. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.wordmark, nav, follow.

42:241.name: Link Profile

Bio.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible

42:241.description: Profile: Avatar, the name as the page h1, tags, bio (scrim 60%) and social Icon Buttons, each needing an aria-label in code. Desktop sits side by side; Mobile stacks with the Compact avatar and a 38px name. .lk-profile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.profile. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

42:354.name: Tab Bar
42:354.description: Filters the Link Rows: All, Studio, Blog, Shop, Support (a role="group" of toggle buttons). Desktop: five equal cells, 8px apart. Mobile: tabs hug their labels and the row scrolls sideways (scrollbar hidden). Swap a Tab to State=Selected to show the active filter. .lk-tabs.

44:203.name: Link Row

Description.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible.

44:203.description: One link: media, then kicker, title, description and tags, then the Go button. The whole row is the link (an <a> when it has an href). Desktop: media 210–280px wide, 160 tall, beside the text. Mobile: media full width, 180 tall, above the text. Media without an image shows scrim at 80%; put an image fill on Media to use one. Kicker is exposed: set its Icon (Studio Command, Blog Feather, Shop/Support Layout Grid) and Label. Hover lifts the row to surface-container-lowest and the Go button to primary. Was Workbench Link Row 118:515. .lk-row. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

44:218.name: Link Tile
44:218.description: A short link under the rows: kicker plus a burst label, centred, at least 80px tall. Three to a row on desktop, one per row on mobile. Hover is new here; code has none yet. .lk-tile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.tiles.
